day5_after_cage_3.text: *Teacher smiled. For the first time in 12 cycles, it was the smile of someone who no longer had to wait for the result.*

day5_after_cage_5.text: *Teacher took my shoulders and turned me back toward my seat. Her fingertips were cold.*

day5_after_cage_6.text: *I went back to the classroom. Sat down. Sea sits next to me. Nurse Riin hands me tea. Everyone is smiling.*

day5_after_cage_7.text: ...{name} only has to stay here. In the seat written in the attendance book.

day5_after_cage_8.text: *I drank the tea. It was warm. From inside the cup, a small voice scraped past. 'Run.' Soon it was buried under the sound of water.*

day5_after_cage_9.text: *The smiles fall into rhythm, one beat at a time. Strange, but familiar. My hand around the cup relaxes first.*

day5_after_cage_10.text: *The word I was trying to remember slipped from the tip of my tongue. It's fine. My name is on the attendance roster.*

day5_after_caught_1.text: *...I opened my eyes. Fluorescent lights flickering. Concrete ceiling. The basement.*

day5_after_caught_2.text: *I tried to move my hands. They won't move. ...Leather straps. Strapped to a chair.*

day5_after_caught_3.text: *The same chair. The same straps. The same fluorescent light. A layout I saw first in the dream.*

day5_after_caught_5.text: ...You attempted deviation? Do you know how dangerous that is?

day5_after_caught_6.text: I'll prepare the final checkup. Just need to draw blood and hook up the IV.

day5_after_caught_7.text: *Ms. Riin disinfects the inside of my elbow. The cold of the alcohol pad touches my skin. I put strength into my wrists.*

day5_after_caught_resist_1.text: *I tensed every muscle. The leather straps dig into my wrists. It hurts. I don't care.*

day5_after_caught_resist_2.text: Get your hands off me...! Stop...!

day5_after_caught_resist_3.text: If you move, it's dangerous. Stay still—

day5_after_caught_resist_4.text: *At that moment. The power went out.*

day5_after_caught_resist_5.text: *In the darkness... I feel the fleeting sensation of someone touching my wrist. Seolhwa's outline seems to overlap with it. But the hand coming free is mine. My fingers dig quickly between the knots.*

day5_after_caught_resist_6.text: *The straps came undone. Seolhwa takes my hand. I thought a translucent hand couldn't be grasped... but it can.*

day5_after_caught_resist_7.text: *I ran through the darkness. It looks as if Seolhwa is leading the way. My fingertips trace the scratches in the wall, and my feet turn toward the emergency exit.*

day5_after_caught_submit_1.text: *The strength drains out. The leather straps no longer hurt. My head drops and my eyes close.*

day5_after_caught_submit_2.text: *The syringe touches my arm. The needle goes in. Cold liquid spreads through my veins.*

day5_after_caught_submit_3.text: *...It grows warm. My body melts. My thoughts blur.*

day5_after_caught_submit_4.text: *I'm forgetting... one name. Who was it? Someone important...*

day5_after_confront_1.text: *From behind — footsteps. Coming up the stairs. One step. One step. Slow. Not running.*

day5_after_confront_2.text: *The footsteps grow closer. The sound of dress shoes hitting concrete. Ms. Eunsu's shoes.*

day5_after_confront_3.text: *Stopped. At the top of the stairs. Ms. Eunsu appeared. Out of breath. Hair disheveled.*

day5_after_confront_4.text: *Teacher catches her breath, forcing the corners of her mouth up. The usual gentle smile. But the facial muscles are twitching subtly.*

day5_after_confront_5.text: {name}. Stop there. The emergency exit side is a restricted area.

day5_after_confront_6.text: *When I backed away, the corners of Ms. Eunsu's mouth fell. The syringe needle flashed briefly beneath the emergency light.*

day5_after_confront_7.text: *Sweat beads on her forehead. Dark circles under her eyes. I wasn't the only one who didn't sleep tonight. A cold wind from the emergency exit passed between us.*

day5_after_confront_8.text: Every chart had the same four fields. Deviation. Tracking. Recovery. Reset.

day5_after_confront_9.text: The 1st time, I was angry. The 2nd time, I tried to find the cause.

day5_after_confront_10.text: From the third time on, your eyes the morning after stayed with me longer than the day you ran away.

day5_after_confront_11.text: So I started by locking the doors. People, the app, even the route to school.

day5_after_confront_12.text: I removed the sounds you hated first. Changed the side dishes, the seat, the order of conversations. The numbers on the chart improved.

day5_after_confront_13.text: ...On Day 1, when you entered the classroom. Even though it was the 13th time, my hands shook. Even though I was opening the same report again.

day5_after_confront_14.text: Even after 12 times, I never get used to it. Every time you check me with eyes that are seeing me for the first time, the sentences in my report broke off.

day5_after_confront_15.text: *Teacher stopped. In front of the emergency exit. Three meters from me. Teacher pulled a syringe from her pocket. Slowly. As if to show me.*

day5_after_confront_16.text: *The liquid inside the syringe glittered under the fluorescent light. On the label, in tiny letters, it said `RESET / S-13`.*

day5_after_confront_17.text: This is the last one, {name}. One shot, and the documents you saw today, your trembling, even the way you look at me will go back into the table.

day5_after_confront_18.text: Back to Day 1. With a face that knows nothing. ...Come back.

day5_after_confront_19.text: *Teacher's hand is shaking. The syringe trembles. A drop falls to the floor. Teacher just keeps holding the syringe.*

day5_after_confront_20.text: *The syringe and the emergency exit. The closed classroom and the open night air. Seolhwa is — visible. Behind Teacher. At the bottom of the stairs. A blurred outline. She says nothing. She just — looks at me.*

day5_after_final_choice.text: *I just have to shove past and run. This person doesn't have the strength to hold me. — And yet my legs won't move. My toes have turned halfway back toward the classroom. My body is obeying before I can.*

day5_after_true_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu's hand trembles. The syringe fell to the floor. Glass shattered against the tile.*

day5_after_true_3.text: *Teacher stepped aside. Eyes closed. The hand holding the syringe dropped down.*

day5_after_true_4.text: *I passed through the emergency exit. With Yuna. The fire escape behind the old wing.*

day5_after_true_5.text: *The dawn air is cold. Beyond the school fence — the road is visible. I looked back.*

day5_after_true_6.text: *Seolhwa is standing inside the emergency exit. She can't step outside the door.*

day5_after_true_10.text: I waited 6 cycles. For you to get out.

day5_after_true_11.text: ...I ended a year ago. If you get out, that's enough.

day5_after_true_11a.text: I'll remember. Lee Seolhwa. The name you returned to me, right to the very end.

day5_after_true_12.text: *Seolhwa's outline scatters. The smell of rainy stairs, a wet school-uniform sleeve, the cold hand that held my left hand all rush in at once.*

day5_after_forget_3.text: ...If all those blank name fields in that basement are coming back to me...

day5_after_forget_4.text: I can't. I don't have the courage to carry all those names out with me.

day5_after_forget_5.text: Please erase me. Make me forget everything.

day5_after_forget_6.text: *Ms. Eunsu raised the syringe. Her hand is shaking.*

day5_after_forget_8.text: *The needle entered my arm. Cold. Consciousness fades.*

day5_after_forget_9.text: *The last thing I saw — Seolhwa. Seolhwa is crying. Her lips move. No sound.*

day5_after_forget_10.text: *...I can read it. The movement of her lips. — "Don't forget"*

day5_after_resist_2.text: You're a victim too, Teacher. You were used by the board.

day5_after_resist_4.text: No. From the 3rd time on, it was my choice.

day5_after_resist_6.text: Even so. If you stay here, the 14th cycle begins. For someone else.

day5_after_resist_7.text: *Ms. Eunsu stopped. Seolhwa appeared. Behind Ms. Eunsu.*

day5_after_resist_9.text: After that day, I watched six more times. The way you smiled whenever you greeted a new name tag. The way you crumbled a little more.

day5_after_resist_11.text: *Ms. Eunsu set the syringe on the floor. ...She stood there for a long time.*

day5_after_resist_12.text: ...If I go outside, everything I did will come to light.

day5_after_resist_13c.text: The 11th Oh Taehyun... said he trusted me. That it was all right because I was his teacher.

day5_after_resist_13d.text: *The teacher stopped speaking. Their hand trembled slightly.*

day5_after_resist_13e.text: ...I erased the memories of that night. The next morning, he asked me, 'Who are you, miss?'

day5_after_resist_13f.text: That was when I understood. What I had made wasn't a relationship. It was a response table. And still, I didn't stop.

day5_after_resist_13g.text: ...How are you going to take me away? After doing something like this to you.

day5_after_resist_14.text: *Ms. Eunsu covered her mouth. Her breath broke twice.*

day5_after_resist_15.text: ...You should face consequences. But it's better than repeating this.

day5_after_ghost_1.text: *My toes won't lift, as if they're stuck to the floor.*

day5_after_ghost_5.text: I watched for 6 cycles. You not being able to decide. This time too. I know. It's a habit.

day5_after_ghost_7.text: *Seolhwa looked straight at me. Eyes that exist neither on camera nor in the attendance book are clearer than anyone's, if only in this moment.*

day5_after_ghost_9.text: *My body moved. My toes turned toward the emergency exit. I took Yuna's hand and ran.*

day5_after_ghost_10.text: *Ms. Eunsu shouted from behind but I didn't stop. I stepped through the emergency exit. Looked back. Seolhwa is standing inside the door. Smiling.*

day5_after_ghost_12.text: *Seolhwa disappeared. Like light. Without a sound. At the same time — an alarm went off inside the building.*

day5_after_ghost_13.text: *The building erupted in noise. Sirens, footsteps, shouting. I could no longer hear Seolhwa's voice. I got out of the school.*
